content.text: Hi, the rice cooker from order ORD-1102 doesn't heat properly. I'd like a refund please.
Sure — to protect your privacy, could you please provide the email address associated with your account?

We need to verify identity first. Ask for email. Then lookup_customer, verify order belongs. Then check order status and delivery date to see if within 30 days. Then request refund if eligible. So first ask for email.
